name: AgentHunter

sources.title: AgentHunter — AI agents directory (3,414 agents listed)
Submit page (JS-rendered; plan selection entry point)

conditions: Free plan requires placing a backlink to AgentHunter on your site
Free plan link is nofollow and sits in a manual review queue of typically 14 days
requirements: AI agents only — directory of 'AI agents'; product must be an AI agent or agentic tool
Free tier: permanent listing, full agent profile with logo/screenshots/description, publish date of your choice, nofollow link, ~14-day manual review, reciprocal backlink required, no support
Listing plan ($79-99 one-time): dofollow link, reviewed within 72 hours, no backlink required, higher placement, lifetime listing
Sponsor plan ($249/week): everything in Listing plus a week-long featured banner, pinned homepage/category placement, one slot in the weekly digest; only one sponsor per period
preparation: Agent name, website URL, short and long description
If using the free plan: a page on your site where the AgentHunter backlink will live
workflow: Choose a plan (free / Listing / Sponsor) via 'Go Submit'
Fill the product submission form with name, URL, description, logo, screenshots, categories
Free plan: place the required AgentHunter backlink, then wait through the ~14-day manual review
Paid Listing: pay one-time fee, reviewed within 72 hours
watchFor: The free plan's backlink requirement is a hard gate — plan where the badge/link goes before submitting
Free-plan outbound link is nofollow; only paid plans get dofollow
Listing price displayed as $99 struck through to $79 — price may fluctuate
Removing the reciprocal backlink later may jeopardize the free listing (requirement is ongoing)
countsAsLive: The agent's public profile page is reachable under agenthunter.io and appears in directory/category listings
unknowns: Exact fields on the submit form (page is JS-rendered and returned no content to a text fetch)
Whether removing the reciprocal backlink triggers delisting
Rejection criteria for the manual review
